result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations: solving a second-order differential equation in z by a power series after the substitution w = v e^{λ z z} with λ = i/4, giving coefficients as ratios of factorial-type products, followed by calculations with exponentials of the form e^{-zzπi} that appear related to the Riemann–Siegel integral and a sum of e^{-nx}.

Substitution with Gaussian factor λ = i/4 removing the zz term
